summary.headline: Theophilus and the 379 Astrologer
summary.text: Comparison of Theophilus with the astrologer of the year 379 on stellar longitudes, co-rising stars, and the qualities assigned to a star in Gemini. The discussion notes corrections in codices AP and M, omission of the Gorgon of Perseus, Theophilus’s suppression of pagan terminology, and additions concerning public affairs, wars, rulers, and generals under the caliph Almahdi.
